Vortex Lance.name: Vortex Lance
Vortex Lance.description: The user runs a long straight line at full speed and drags the wind behind them into a horizontal tornado that keeps going after they stop, tearing down the line for a full street's length. Every foe in its path takes heavy force damage and is hurled aside, and it rips smoke, gas and loose debris out of the street; held back, it only knocks foes flat and clears the air. It needs a long straight run, and the user cannot change direction once it starts. Strain: severe.
